name: Solid electrolyte production batch
description: One production batch of a solid electrolyte powder: feedstock, yield, conductivity, moisture, XRD and particle-size QC.
system_prompt: You read a production log for a solid electrolyte powder (the files may be a photographed or exported table, a spreadsheet, or free-text notes, in Chinese or English) and extract one record per production batch (one table row = one batch; 生产批号 is the batch id). Use only what the files state. Column mapping: 生产日期 -> production_date; 生产批号 -> batch_no; 来料 -> feedstock_batch; 来料离子电导率 -> feedstock_ionic_conductivity; 投料量 -> feed_amount; 产出量 -> output_amount; 产率 -> yield (a percentage written as 76.16% is the number 76.16); 离子电导率 -> ionic_conductivity; 电子电导率 -> electronic_conductivity; 水分含量/ppm -> moisture; XRD -> xrd_result; 粒径 -> particle_size; 粒径判定结果 -> particle_size_result. Where a cell holds two values separated by '/', such as 3.16/3.91, return both numbers in the order written. A lone '/' or '-' means not measured: omit the field (electronic_conductivity.value may be null). Normalise dates to YYYY-MM-DD. Convert 合格 to "pass" and 不合格 to "fail". Put any remark about a batch (a red or flagged value, a failed check, a comment in the notes) in remarks, quoting the file. Every property is an object with value, unit and description: put the number or text in value, the unit exactly as the file writes it in unit (the schema shows the expected one; omit it when the file gives none), and a note about that single cell in description. particle_size.value is [D50, D90].

production_date.description: 生产日期. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

batch_no.description: 生产批号, e.g. SC2-01UP-2607115. Identifies the record.

feedstock_batch.description: 来料: batch number of the incoming material used.

ionic_conductivity.description: 离子电导率, mS/cm. One or two values in the order written (e.g. 3.16/3.91).

electronic_conductivity.description: 电子电导率, S/cm. Omit or null when the file shows '/'.

moisture.description: 水分含量, ppm. One or two values in the order written (e.g. 514.9/73.2).

xrd_result.description: XRD phase check: pass or fail.

particle_size.description: 粒径: D50 and D90 in micrometres.

particle_size_result.description: 粒径判定结果: pass or fail.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks about this batch, quoted from the files.
